definition: Tomáš Mikolov is a Czech computer scientist known for his work on neural language models and word representations.
details: He was the lead author of the 2013 paper that introduced the word2vec models, a technique for learning word embeddings from text. He later co-authored research associated with fastText. Mikolov received his PhD from Brno University of Technology and worked at Microsoft Research, Google Brain, and Facebook AI Research. In 2020, he joined the Czech Institute of Informatics, Robotics and Cybernetics at the Czech Technical University in Prague.

explainer.lead: Tomáš Mikolov is a Czech computer scientist (born 1982). His work spans natural language processing, word2vec, informatics and artificial intelligence.

contributions.name: In 2025, Mikolov co-founded BottleCap AI, a Prague-based company developing efficient foundation models.

timeline.what: In 2012, Mikolov spent three months as an intern at Microsoft Research in Redmond, working with Geoffrey Zweig on recurrent neural network language models.
After completing his PhD in 2012, Mikolov joined Google Brain.
His 2012 dissertation, Statistical Language Models Based on Neural Networks, reported the best published performance at the time on a language-modelling benchmark based on the Penn Treebank.
Receives the Neuron Prize for important scientific discovery
Receives the Silver Medal of the President of the Senate
